name: ElementsKit
couldBuild: The four or five widgets you actually place, registered against Elementor's widget API, plus a header/footer builder and a mega-menu widget.
stillMissing: Nobody buys an addon pack for four widgets. The product is 68 widgets and 500+ prebuilt sections, and the real cost is that they must all keep working through every Elementor release — a dependency that breaks on somebody else's schedule.
requirements: Widget registration against Elementor's API with live editing controls
Header and footer builder with display conditions
Mega-menu widget driven by WordPress menus
A section/template library users can insert and edit
Compatibility passes against each Elementor release

alternatives.name: ElementsKit Lite
alternatives.desc: A large free widget set; the header builder and most sections are paid.

alternatives.name: Essential Addons
alternatives.desc: The other big Elementor addon pack, also generous for free.
